Author: inliver233
Message:
feat: implement decision-4 auto_low_risk graded adoption chain (AI supervision)

Completes the largest remaining requirement gap from the 2026-08-15 review:
the ai-supervision decision-4 adoption chain is now wired end to end.

- internal/ai: Supervisor.WithAdopter wires a deterministic executor that runs
  ONLY in auto_low_risk mode, only for non-abstaining advisories at/above the
  configured confidence floor (default 0.8, clamped [0.5,1)), only for actions
  the validator whitelist marks reversible (EXPLAIN_ALERT, NODE_ORDER,
  BACKUP_ORDER), and never when a risk flag or task family demands human
  confirmation (disaster/conflict/import/recovery are structurally excluded).
  Outcomes are audited as auto_adopted/system with a deterministic effect
  reference; shadow/advisory modes keep zero-effect behavior (mode gate test).
- internal/store + migration 0048: ai_adoption_effects persists reversible
  effects (inspection_summary, alert_note, node/backup order hints) that
  expire with their advisory and are idempotent per (request, kind); outcome
  decision check extended with auto_adopted.
- internal/controller ai_adoption.go: the executor re-checks every hard gate
  against CURRENT store state - orderings must cover every currently
  eligible node exactly once (partial/stale orderings fail closed), alert
  notes re-run the secret scan and only annotate cited alerts, everything
  degrades to no-hint on lookup errors. Consumed hints only reorder nodes
  WITHIN deterministic rank tiers (available nodes, backup target, storage
  repair) and can never promote an ineligible node or hide an eligible one.
- Admin endpoint POST /api/admin/ai/advisories/{id}/adopt reuses the same
  executor and gates for manual adoption (accepted/admin audit row); AI
  status panel exposes adoption counters; the React AI page gains the
  adopt button, adoption stats and the auto-adopted cluster summary.
- Real PostgreSQL tests: ordering hard gates (full/partial/stale), alert
  note merge + secret refusal, supervisor mode/confidence gates. Full real
  suite 42 PASS / 0 SKIP / 0 FAIL (baseline 39 + 3).
